name: Pending Nominations
query:
SELECT
    bm.name AS "Membership ID:Link/Board Members:180",
    bm.society_name_1 AS "Society Name:Data:250",
    bm.state AS "State:Data:150",
    bm.district AS "District:Data:150",
    bm.share_capital AS "Share Capital:Currency:150",

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM `tabBoard Members` bm2
        LEFT JOIN `tabNominee  Form` nf2
            ON nf2.membership_id = bm2.name
        WHERE bm2.status = 'Approved'
        AND nf2.name IS NULL
    ) AS " :Int:1"

FROM `tabBoard Members` bm

LEFT JOIN `tabNominee  Form` nf
    ON nf.membership_id = bm.name

WHERE bm.status = 'Approved'
AND nf.name IS NULL

ORDER BY bm.society_name_1
